name: The Cloudbreaker
description: A mystical artifact said to summon the Ally and restore beauty, hidden in the merrow's lake.

description_citations.text: "Shadowmoor (anthology)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ehroe poisons the merrow's lake with cramoisy, killing the merrow, and the elves retrieve the Cloudbreaker.
timeline.quote: Ehroe pours the cramoisy extract into the lake, and soon it is full of bloated, dead merrow

citation.text: "Shadowmoor (anthology)", section "The Cloudbreaker, by Jenna Helland". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The elves of Dusklight find the Cloudbreaker after suffering attacks from nearby merrow, then kill the merrow with a strong poison.
timeline.quote: After the elves killed off the merrow with a strong poison

citation.text: "Safehold", section "Known safeholds". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: An army of creatures from the Wilt-Leaf Wood attacks Dusklight Safehold; the elves refuse to use the Cloudbreaker and the safehold is destroyed, with Cavan the only survivor.
timeline.quote: The elves did not use the Cloudbreaker, feeling they were unworthy of it, and the safehold was destroyed.

citation.text: "Safehold", section "Known safeholds". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A magical stone that, according to myth, could summon a powerful creature to act as a defender.
